title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant
- Location: Belfast City Centre
- Contract: Part-time (20-25 hours) 10-4 or 10-3 M-F Permanent Office-based
- Salary: £14.50 - £16.00 an hour

Reed Accountancy is proud to represent an established and reputable company in Belfast City Centre who are seeking a motivated and ambitious Accounts Assistant to join their dynamic team, supporting their accountancy function.

This is a perfect opportunity for an Accounts Assistant seeking part-time hours across 5-days within a supportive working environment.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Review and process supplier invoices accurately and efficiently.
- Organise and execute regular supplier payments.
- Reconcile accounts against supplier statements.
- Handle invoice and payment queries via phone and email.
- Manage petty cash and bank deposits

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Minimum of 2-years' experience in an accounts administrative position
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.
- High level of attention to detail.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

For more information, including package details, please contact Mary at Reed Belfast, apply via this advert, or contact me confidentially on LinkedIn

title: Accounts Clerk
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company

A well-established and growing organisation is seeking an Accounts Clerk to join its finance team on a part-time basis (3 days per week). With a strong reputation in its sector and a collaborative working environment, the business offers excellent training, development opportunities and flexibility, including the potential for hybrid working arrangements in the future.

Your new role

As Accounts Clerk, you will play a key role within the finance function, with a primary focus on credit control. Approximately 70% of your time will be dedicated to managing debtor ledgers, chasing outstanding payments, reconciling customer accounts, allocating payments and handling customer queries. The remaining 30% of the role will involve purchase ledger duties, invoice processing, cashbook administration and financial reconciliations. You'll also assist with cash flow reporting and support the wider finance team as required. Experience with Sage 200 or QuickBooks would be beneficial, although full training can be provided.

What you'll need to succeed

To be successful in this role, you will have previous experience in a credit control position and be confident managing customer accounts and collections processes. Strong attention to detail, excellent organisational skills and the ability to communicate effectively with customers and colleagues are essential. Experience of purchase ledger and invoice processing would be advantageous. Knowledge of Sage 200 or QuickBooks is desirable but not essential, as training will be provided.

What you'll get in return
- Salary of £32,000 pro rata.
- Part-time position working 3 days per week.
- Flexible working options available.
- Hybrid working opportunities available in the future.
- Full training in finance systems including Sage 200 and QuickBooks.
- Excellent company benefits package.
- Free on-site parking.
- Career development opportunities within a growing organisation.

What you need to do now

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant (REED Exclusive)
- Location: Belfast City Centre
- Job Type: Full-time Permanent Hybrid Working
- Salary: £31,000 per annum

Reed Accountancy & Finance are exclusively working with a reputable company based in Belfast City Centre who are recruiting for a Finance Assistant to join their team on permanent, full-time basis.

The successful Finance Assistant will join a dynamic accounts team and be offered comprehensive exposure to various critical financial functions, essential for the smooth operation of their busy Finance Department.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Treasury / Cash Management: Handle daily receipts and allocations to ensure accurate financial tracking.
- Client Reporting: Generate and manage client statements, remittances, and VAT reporting, ensuring clear and precise financial communication with clients.
- Credit Control: Implement effective credit control procedures to maintain healthy cash flow and minimize financial risk.
- Purchase Ledger Management: Oversee the purchase ledger to ensure all expenditures are accurately recorded and reconciled.
- Ad Hoc Duties: Perform additional tasks as needed to support the finance team, contributing to the overall efficiency of the department.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- A minimum of 2 years' experience in an account's role, with a strong emphasis on credit control procedures.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
- Experienced in managing online banking systems.
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
- Strong communication skills, confident and courteous in interactions with colleagues and clients.

For more information, including package details, please contact Mary at Reed Belfast, apply via this advert, or contact me confidentially on LinkedIn

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING TRAINEESHIP (REMOTE)

Become a Digital Marketing Professional and Build Real-World Experience

Are you interested in digital marketing, online business, and helping organisations grow through effective marketing strategies? Do you want to gain practical experience while developing skills that employers are actively looking for?

We are offering a Digital Marketing Traineeship designed to help aspiring digital marketers develop industry-relevant knowledge through structured learning and practical projects.

What You Will Learn

Throughout the traineeship, you will develop an understanding of:
- Digital Marketing Fundamentals
- Marketing Strategy and Planning
- Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
- Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Advertising
- Social Media Marketing
- Content Marketing
- Email Marketing
- Google Analytics and Marketing Analytics
- Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)
- Customer Journey Mapping
- Branding and Positioning
- Market Research and Competitor Analysis
- Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Marketing
- Marketing Automation
- Campaign Planning and Performance Measurement
- Marketing Reporting and Data Analysis

Practical Experience

You will work on realistic marketing projects that may include:
- Developing digital marketing strategies
- SEO audits and optimisation recommendations
- Social media campaign planning
- Content creation and marketing calendars
- Email marketing campaigns
- Marketing analytics and reporting
- Website optimisation projects
- Competitor research
- Brand positioning exercises
- Portfolio projects demonstrating your marketing skills

This practical experience will help you develop a professional portfolio that demonstrates your capabilities to future employers.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for individuals who:
- Have an interest in marketing, business, and technology
- Enjoy analysing data and solving problems
- Have good communication skills
- Are creative and eager to learn
- Can work independently and manage their time effectively
- Have basic computer skills

No previous digital marketing experience is required. Successful applicants will undertake our paid Digital Marketing training programme before progressing into employment. The cost of the training is the responsibility of the learner, and full guidance and support will be provided throughout the programme.

Benefits
- Remote and flexible learning
- Industry-relevant curriculum
- Portfolio development opportunities
- Practical project experience
- Mentoring and personalised feedback
- Career guidance and employability support
- Opportunity to develop skills sought by modern employers

Entry Requirements
- A good level of written English
- Access to a computer and internet connection
- Motivation to learn and develop professionally

Career Opportunities

Upon successful completion, learners may pursue roles such as:
- Digital Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Specialist
- SEO Executive
- PPC Executive
- Content Marketing Executive
- Social Media Executive
- Email Marketing Executive
- Marketing Coordinator
- Marketing Analyst
- Growth Marketing Executive
- Performance Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Assistant

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.
